title: Supplementary managed interfaces and public subnet separation need deployment verification
remediation: The sponsor network security authority and system owner map the assessed external and key internal interfaces, public components and approved external connections. Review public-to-internal subnet separation, boundary devices and monitoring settings, and verify representative approved and denied connections using benign synthetic observations. Record inherited protection and findings at the scope of this contract.

milestones.title: Collect the approved interface and subnet diagram, effective boundary protection and monitoring settings, and redacted permitted and denied connection results
